tokens.name: color-bg
tokens.usage: Screen background on every page of the app; also the splash ground. Text on it: color-text (12.3:1), color-accent-700 (5.4:1).

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, secondary buttons, segmented controls and neutral tags sit on this white over color-bg.

tokens.name: color-surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a secondary button.

tokens.name: color-press
tokens.usage: Pressed state of a tappable list row (.bk-row:active).

tokens.name: color-text
tokens.usage: All body copy, headings and numbers, on color-bg and color-surface (12.3:1). Also the 2px rule above an insight block.

tokens.name: color-neutral-900
tokens.usage: Same ink as color-text; the darkest step of the warm neutral scale.

tokens.name: color-neutral-700
tokens.usage: Secondary text where it must stay readable on color-bg (4.3:1: passes only at 19px bold / 24px+).

tokens.name: color-muted
tokens.usage: The app's .text-muted: captions, field labels, sub-lines, inactive segment text. On color-bg 3.4:1 and on color-surface 3.7:1 — below 4.5:1 in the source; kept exact. Use only for 11–13px supporting text, never for the only copy of a number.

tokens.name: color-neutral-600
tokens.usage: Inactive tab-bar icons and labels (2.8:1 on color-bg; the source's choice, kept).

tokens.name: color-placeholder
tokens.usage: Input placeholder text only (2.1:1 on white).

tokens.name: color-neutral-400
tokens.usage: Disabled and decorative strokes.

tokens.name: color-neutral-300
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and segmented controls; the range track.

tokens.name: color-neutral-200
tokens.usage: Quiet fills inside cards.

tokens.name: color-divider
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines: table rows, list rows, the tab bar's top edge, .hr, the neutral tag border.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: Baketly olive. Primary buttons, the selected segment, the active tab, the Pay disc, eyebrow labels, range thumb, focus ring. White on it is 3.8:1 — the source's pair; keep button labels 13px semibold or larger.

tokens.name: color-accent-600
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a primary button.

tokens.name: color-accent-700
tokens.usage: Links, ghost buttons, accent and outline tag text, positive amounts (change due, profit). 5.4:1 on color-bg, 5.1:1 on color-accent-100.

tokens.name: color-accent-300
tokens.usage: Border of an outline tag.

tokens.name: color-accent-100
tokens.usage: Fill of an accent tag and other soft olive highlights.

tokens.name: color-kicker
tokens.usage: Wheat gold. The .card-kicker label above a card title and the scan-frame corners. 2.4:1 on white — decorative label only, always followed by a title in color-text.

tokens.name: color-danger
tokens.usage: Money short or owed (negative change, a shortfall), the swipe-to-delete disc. 4.9:1 with white.

tokens.name: color-stock-out
tokens.usage: Stock count when an item is sold out.

tokens.name: color-stock-low
tokens.usage: Stock count when two or fewer are left.

tokens.name: color-alert-dot
tokens.usage: 8px dot marking an item that needs attention in a sale list.

tokens.name: color-todo
tokens.usage: Home to-do dot for an open task.

tokens.name: color-todo-done
tokens.usage: Home to-do dot once picked.

tokens.name: color-frame
tokens.usage: The olive field behind the phone frame on the web build and the loading thumbnail. Not used inside screens.

tokens.name: color-brand-green
tokens.usage: Deep bottle green of the app icon and the loaf mark. Identity only (icon tile, splash mark); not a UI colour.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big money figures on Home and Analytics; always tabular numerals.

styles.name: insight
styles.sample: Each babka costs $0.87 to make. You keep $9.13.
styles.usage: The one-sentence finding under an eyebrow, set above a 2px color-text rule.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: h6: section heads inside cards, totals rows.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Add an hourly rate and Baketly will show your true profit on every bake.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Table cells, dense rows. Buttons use it at 600.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Sub-lines under titles, in color-muted; segment labels at 600.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase overline in color-accent above a headline or insight.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase .card-kicker in color-kicker above a card title.

styles.name: tab-label
styles.usage: Tab-bar labels under 20px icons; the Pay tab at 600.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between icon buttons; segmented-control padding and gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Label-to-input gap in a field; tab-bar top padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap inside buttons (icon + label) and between tags.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between items inside a card; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Top padding of the dashboard; header bottom margin.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding; card row padding; gap between fields.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Card padding; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter on dashboard screens.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Onboarding gutter; space before a primary action.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Space between major blocks on a screen.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: Progress bars, onboarding step bars, range track.

tokens.name: radius-seg
tokens.usage: The selected option inside a segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small tiles, thumbnails, list chips.

tokens.name: radius-btn
tokens.usage: Buttons and the segmented control's outer shell.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Text inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Sheets and medium panels (the source's --radius-md).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags; icon buttons and the Pay disc use 50%.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards; range thumb.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: The Pay disc and floating actions.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (casts upward).
